storage: Dry beans: airtight jar at room temperature, away from damp, 6–12 months. Sprouts: in a covered box lined with a paper towel in the fridge, 2–3 days. Cook (do not eat raw) if they smell sour or feel slimy, and throw them away if they do.
looksLike: Tiny oblong beans about the size of a rice grain, light brown to beige, often with a slightly mottled skin. After 1–2 days of soaking and sprouting they grow short white tails.
shelfLife: About 6–12 months dry in a sealed pack. Sprouts last only 2–3 days.

usedIn.raw: 30 g dry (2½ tbsp), giving about 80 g sprouts for the usal
